'''Reconnaissance droids''' were assigned to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Repair Station]] [[M13]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mycroft]]. The [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] detachment assigned to the facility used them to help patrol and defend the base.<ref name="Repair">{{WEGCite|story=Assault on Repair Station M13 (adventure)|book=Star Wars Campaign Pack}}</ref>
